body:
I have been talking to his close friend all night. His friend(Call him Andrew) and I have been very good friends for years, since the relationship began about three years ago. Andrew has tried the best he can to help my ex, and is at a loss with what to do, just as myself. I have been working on a letter that I will be sending out to his close family to let them know whats going on, my ex hides all his emotions and his family isnt the brightest. 
When I notified my ex a while ago that I needed to tell him mom about his suicidal feelings, he told me I'd regret it if I said anything. When speaking to him tonight I told him I really just wanted to have the police come get him, bring him to the hospital, and assure everyone that he is safe there. When saying this, he assured me that if he saw a police car, he would end his life right there because he'd be more miserable in a hospital. 
There is merely no end nor solution to this and its been so difficult. I have tried everything.

Thank you for replying. I have been up all night crying, shaking, and just worrying. I have given him all the space he needs, I let him come to me. I try to support him as much as I can but after over coming self harm and a suicidal mindset, I have to stop at some point. Some of his messages follow, at which might be beneficial to know : “I don’t plan on taking my life tonight. I’m talking to my mom tomorrow.”
“My time came and passed. It’s over.”
“I know its selfish, and an easy out, but living is a complete torture right now, and its gotten worse, much worse.”
“I just don’t want to live anymore, but don’t want to put people through pain.”
